reason: I'd run the free 15-page plan on one client site, but I'm not dropping the tool I already pay for on a service with no reviews. It says outright it won't get past bot protection, and a few of my clients sit behind exactly that.
objection: Will it actually capture my clients' sites? It won't touch anything with bot protection, and I'm not convinced a pasted browser session survives a month of daily captures before the login expires and the run quietly fails.
would_change_my_mind: If the free run gets my worst client site right, logged-in pages included, with clean before/afters and no false alerts for two or three weeks, I'd take the $79 lifetime Studio deal before the 100 spots go.
